description: Facts shared by the CSF and AI RMF tracks: the intake menus (scripts/intake.py turns the typed numbers into these values), the domains and certifications, and the question types in order of how demanding they are. Read through scripts/options.py; no script keeps its own copy.

questions.prompt: Certifications held (pick all that apply, e.g. "2 3")

options.label: None - no AI in use or planned
Some - AI is in use, or being built or piloted
Unsure - not known (shadow use is possible)
Consumer - uses AI (including fine-tuning an existing model for own use)
Producer - builds models that are the product or a core asset, or distributes models to others
Both

questions.prompt: Highest technology rung reached (each includes the ones below)

options.label: base - LLM use, no access beyond the prompt
rag - the LLM reads org data through retrieval (RAG, knowledge graph)
mcp - the LLM has tools: it can read, write and take actions
agentic - operates with minimal human oversight; autonomous multi-step work
internal - day-to-day business processes; output stays inside the org
code_generation - AI builds or maintains business applications
customer_facing - AI inside an app, or output reaching customers (including calling a SaaS LLM API from your own app)
third_party_embedded - AI bundled in a tool you use (ITSM, ticketing, RPA with a built-in LLM)

questions.prompt: Modifiers (pick all that apply, or leave blank for none)

options.label: poc - any PoCs or experiments running
self_hosted - you host the model or its infrastructure yourself (including a fine-tuned model)
builds_on_base_model - producers only: you build on an existing base model
unsanctioned_use - shadow AI is known or suspected

questions.prompt: Is the CSF assessment part of this engagement and done before the AI RMF assessment?

options.label: Yes
No
Yes
No
